tool_args.rationale: The pilot has too few informative temporal observations to identify the normalized hysteresis law. A fine trajectory can distinguish its transient shape before model fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary relaxation model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The opposing-step responses and one unchanged-input row do not identify the transient law or distinguish competing relaxation mechanisms.
It is unrelated to identifying the temporal response.
